lines: Adjusted Net Income, which excludes certain items affecting comparability in each period as shown in the reconciliation tables at the end of this release, was $83 million, at the high end of our outlook, and compares to $88 million in the third quarter of 2025.
The Company is reiterating its full year 2026 Net Revenues outlook of a range of +1% to +3%, compared to 2025 Net Revenues of $3,721 million.
Given the adjustments made during the third quarter, the Company expects Net Income in the range of $307 million to $320 million, with EPS of $1.45 to $1.51.
Full-year Adjusted EPS guidance is unchanged at $1.57 to $1.63.
The Company is reiterating its full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA outlook of $660 million and $675 million.
Based on the full-year outlook, the implied fourth quarter 2026 Net Revenues range is expected to be -3% to +3% compared to fourth quarter 2025 Net Revenues of $1,034 million.
